summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of the 5-fix batch (iteration 23). Backend: 10/10 pytest pass covering normalize-sources idempotency (1st call returns {normalized:0} on re-run, 2nd idempotent), fix-null-types idempotency ({fixed_expense:0, fixed_income:0} on re-run), process-factura-pdfs 200 shape, _regex_fill_card_info unit tests (extracts credit_limit=30000/pago_total=27677.32/deferred_balance=5432.10 from 'CUPO AUTORIZADO $30,000.00 / PAGO DE CONTADO $27,677.32 / SALDO DIFERIDO $5,432.10' + does NOT override existing values), regression 200 on credit-cards/budget-categories/transactions/gmail-documents, bulk-categorize with single id. Frontend (1920x1080, admin): (1) TransactionEditModal present in /components/shared/ with all 10 data-testids rendered in single mode (tem-category-select, tem-subcategory-select, tem-sri-category-select, tem-sri-subcategory-select, tem-establishment-input, tem-beneficiario-input, tem-is-business-switch, tem-applies-iva-switch, tem-save-btn, tem-cancel-btn); (2) TabPorRevisar has NO inline dropdowns — each row has review-edit-btn-<id> (9 rows), toolbar has review-bulk-categorize-btn with text 'Categorizar (0)' disabled at 0 and 'Categorizar (9)' enabled when all selected; clicking bulk btn opens the shared modal in bulk mode showing ONLY category+subcategory (sri, establishment, switches all absent as spec requires); (3) Transactions.js has actions-<id> dropdown (101 rows) → recat-<id> menu item opens the same shared modal in single mode with all 5 field families (cat+sri_cat+est+beneficiario+switches). No regressions in navigation or Spanish UI. The only non-blocking console warning observed: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' when modal opens in single mode — DialogDescription is only rendered in bulk mode. A11y polish, not functional.

issues: Missing <DialogDescription> in single mode triggers Radix a11y warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Add a short description (or aria-describedby={undefined} explicit) for the single-edit branch. Non-blocking.

Click review-edit-btn-<id> → transaction-edit-modal opens in single mode with all 10 data-testids present (tem-category-select, tem-subcategory-select, tem-sri-category-select, tem-sri-subcategory-select, tem-establishment-input, tem-beneficiario-input, tem-is-business-switch, tem-applies-iva-switch, tem-save-btn, tem-cancel-btn)

action_items: (Low priority a11y) Add <DialogDescription> in TransactionEditModal single-mode branch to silence Radix aria-describedby warning. Currently only rendered when isBulk=true (line 68).
critical_code_review_comments: TransactionEditModal.jsx is the single source of truth — DRY win. Clean prop contract (open, transaction, bulkCount, onSave, onClose). Good.
documents._regex_fill_card_info: 'only fill if None' policy is correct for the PacifiCard scenario (avoids clobbering values already extracted by LLM). The due_date year-fix helper is a nice bonus.

documents._upsert_card_from_statement line 209: for credit_limit, correctly uses 'card_info.get("credit_limit") if not None else existing_card.get("credit_limit", 0)' — prevents overwrite to None when statement doesn't have it. Same pattern used for saldo_diferido and pago_total. Good.
transactions.fix_null_transaction_types is idempotent by construction (only matches transaction_type:None/missing). Safe to re-run.
sri_match.normalize-sources legacy_sources correctly includes 'gmail' in the whitelist (line 384).
TabPorRevisar.jsx: onSave bulk handler POSTs to bulk-categorize; confirmed via toolbar flow. The removal of inline per-row dropdowns is a nice UX cleanup.
Transactions.js row 'Recategorizar' DropdownMenuItem wires to setRecatTx(transaction) then POST bulk-categorize with ids:[tx.id] — acceptable (reuses bulk endpoint for a single id).

constants/categories.js is well-structured; PERSONAL_CATEGORIES + SRI_CATEGORIES + INCOME_SOURCES + getSubcategories all exported; no duplicate local constants remain in Transactions.js or CargarValidar.js.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Bulk-categorize test used an existing transaction with its own category (no mutation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 fixes in iteration 23 verified end-to-end. /app/backend/tests/test_iteration23_batch.py is reusable as regression: normalize-sources idempotency, fix-null-types idempotency, _regex_fill_card_info unit test (no PDF upload needed — directly tests helper), bulk-categorize, and all regression GETs. TransactionEditModal is the shared single source of truth for both TabPorRevisar and Transactions.js. Only polish left is the DialogDescription a11y in single mode.
